analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction with branch staff conduct and alleges material distress (humiliation) under CH-1.
analysis.summary: The customer, who has a stammer, visited the Kingsbridge Road branch on a Friday to pay in cash for their business. They say the counter staff member sighed, rolled his eyes, said 'I haven't got all day' and told them to use the machine. They felt humiliated. They want an apology and better staff training, and ask for email-only contact. The handler has informed the branch manager, raised a CCTV request and asked about support needs; the customer said no.

timeline.event: Customer visited Kingsbridge Road branch; alleges dismissive treatment by counter staff member
Branch manager informed, CCTV request raised, customer asked by email about support needs (said no), email-only contact flagged

analysis.severity_reason: CH-6 classes a complaint about staff conduct as Medium. No financial loss is stated and no fraud, legal threat or risk of harm is indicated.

vulnerability.suggested_support: Keep email-only contact, which is already flagged. Offer a named contact and extra time to respond. Staff should be mindful of the stammer in any branch interaction. The customer declined further support, so respect that.

analysis.routing_reason: Staff conduct complaint with no fraud, lending, systemic, legal or technical trigger under ESC-1. The customer declined support, no financial difficulty, bereavement, risk to wellbeing or financial abuse is indicated, so VUL-4 referral is not triggered. The handler can resolve it.

policy_citations.quote: *Medium*: financial loss between £100 and £1,000, repeated service failure (the customer has contacted us three or more times about the same issue), or a complaint about staff conduct.
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The complaint is about staff conduct, so severity is Medium.

policy_citations.quote: Handlers must look for indicators of vulnerability in everything the customer says or writes, including indirect statements
policy_citations.how_it_applies: The stammer is a health-related indicator, so it is recorded as a possible vulnerability.

policy_citations.quote: Reasonable adjustments must be offered and recorded, for example a preferred contact method
policy_citations.how_it_applies: Email-only contact is the customer's preference and is flagged on the account.

policy_citations.quote: Complaints handlers resolve complaints themselves unless one of the following applies
policy_citations.how_it_applies: No escalation trigger applies, so the handler keeps the case.

evidence.quote: The man at the counter sighed, rolled his eyes and said 'I haven't got all day'.
I have a stammer and it took me a while to explain.
I want an apology and I want staff to be trained properly.
Cust asked by email if any support needed - says no, just wants apology.
pay in cash for my business
